title: UNet 3+: A Full-Scale Connected UNet for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Full-scale skip connections, full-scale deep supervision, and a classification-guided module that suppresses predictions in images without the target.
adaptation: Full-scale skips including a stride-1 stem; CGM as a cell-level inactive-present gate (42 train cells with inactive) to cut BMRK inactive false positives.
min_experiment: Arm: UNet 3+ decoder with stem + CGM (PF encoder); baseline: house PF; CV inactive IoU and precision, gridline IoU. Kill if inactive IoU < +0.02 and gridline n.d.
evidence: R: gains on two medical datasets (liver, spleen), fewer parameters than UNet++.

alt_notes.adaptation: Full-scale skips including a stride-1 stem on ResNet-34; classification-guided module as an image-level inactive-present gate (42 train cells have inactive), aimed at BMRK inactive false positives.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm UNet 3+ (ResNet-34, PF) vs house PF; 5-fold CV inactive IoU and precision, gridline IoU; kill: inactive IoU n.d. and gridline < +0.03. About 10 GPU-h.
